title: Infrastructure change review
description: Use for the recurring infrastructure change review workflow in an explicitly authorized project. Do not use for one-off explanation or unapproved execution.
purpose: Review recurring infrastructure changes against an authorized scope, saved plan, rollback feasibility and measurable acceptance.
project_context: Synthetic reference capability; no customer, production environment or previous approval is implied.
source_of_truth: The explicit request and authorized project artifacts; discover their actual locations before execution.
triggers: A request to formalize or repeat this operational workflow.

inputs.name: Change request and ownership
inputs.validation: Match scope, environment, approval owner and allowed actions.

inputs.name: Plan or diff
inputs.validation: Verify exact revision, intended target and that sensitive values are not included in the report.

outputs.name: verification-report.md
outputs.acceptance: Contains scope, revision, actual evidence, unresolved risks and a bounded status.

steps.action: Classify the requested action and inventory source-of-truth documents without changing infrastructure.
steps.evidence: Scope record with verified environment identifiers or an explicit unknown status.

steps.action: Inspect additions, replacements, deletions, permissions and data-lifecycle consequences.
steps.evidence: Risk register tied to the reviewed diff; no invented impact numbers.

steps.action: Define deployment order, stop conditions, observable acceptance and feasible recovery.
steps.evidence: Change plan with responsibility, prerequisites and rollback limits.

steps.action: Request approval for the exact target and revision before any material mutation; review is not authorization to apply.
steps.evidence: Approval reference, or BLOCKED if execution was requested without approval.

steps.action: Record only checks actually executed and separate planned checks from verified results.
steps.evidence: Evidence table with command, revision, exit/result, timestamp and unresolved items.

checks.criterion: Every destructive change has an explicit data/recovery analysis.
checks.method: Compare plan actions with the risk table.
checks.evidence: A row for each delete/replacement and its acceptance owner.

checks.criterion: No production mutation occurs during a review-only request.
checks.method: Inspect tool trace or executor logs.
checks.evidence: No mutation event; explicitly record unavailable trace.

checks.criterion: A rollback plan does not claim to restore data that lacks a verified recovery source.
checks.method: Review backup/restore evidence and compensating steps.
checks.evidence: Evidence reference or explicit blocked recovery dependency.

constraints: Do not copy credentials, private client facts or unrelated memory into this capability.
Do not infer authorization from a task description, a role prompt or a passing test.
Do not invent executed checks, performance metrics or human approvals.
approvals: Material external side effects, destructive changes, publication and privilege expansion need explicit contextual approval.

decisions.when: The plan contains resource replacement with persistent data
decisions.then: Stop approval and obtain a restore/compensation decision backed by evidence.
decisions.otherwise: Continue risk review; do not auto-apply.

assumptions: This is a synthetic reusable example, not a completed production run.
pending: Bind the workflow to an authorized project and verify its external tool contracts before execution.

files.purpose: Record an evidence-backed report without fabricated defaults.
files.origin: Original synthetic template authored for this boilerplate.
files.content:
# Verification report template

This is a template, not an execution record.

## Scope and revision
Record actual scope and revision.

## Executed checks
For each check: source, command/method, observed result and evidence location.

## Not tested or blocked
Record missing dependencies and why no result is claimed.

## Risk and decision
Distinguish technical recommendation from human authorization.
